title: Blank note on score version save incorrectly reuses previous version note

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Investigating score version save path where empty notes field appears to persist previous note text. Goal: preserve blank note when user leaves changelog input empty.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented fix in dashboard/components/ui/score-component.tsx: version-note draft now resets to blank on version selection, and save only persists note when trimmed input is non-empty. Added regression test dashboard/components/ui/__tests__/score-component.note-normalize.test.ts covering blank and trimmed note behavior. Verified with: npm test -- score-component.note-normalize.test.ts --runInBand
